children: Overview
Canada MarTech platform's Q2 revenue fell 61% yr/yr due to changes at major customers
Q2 net income and EBITDA declined sharply from Q2 2025
Company repurchased and cancelled 131,000 shares under NCIB program
Outlook
Company did not provide specific guidance for the current quarter or full year in press release
Result Drivers
CUSTOMER MODEL CHANGES - Co said revenue decline was due to operating model changes at two major customers, with recent improvement in activity from one
EFFICIENCY INITIATIVES - Co attributed lower operating expenses to ongoing efficiency and cost optimization measures, including increased use of AI-developed tools
GROWTH INVESTMENT - Co said it continued to invest in business development and customer engagement despite lower revenues
